candidates.title: Split Screen Adoption Certificate Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout with a live pet name input field and desktop companion verification badge preview.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 71.8% conversion rate and takes a long time (mean 1017s); giving a clear dual-column certificate creation experience boosts user engagement.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Name your new desktop pet and finalize your official adoption registry.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Companion Calibration Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a desktop companion workspace calibration screen before final welcome to test pet screen placement and window collision.
candidates.why: Finish step has low conversion (64.8%) and users submitted support emails regarding pets not displaying properly on desktop screens.

new_desktop_calibration.headline: Calibrate Desktop Workspace
new_desktop_calibration.body: Verify screen boundaries and position your companion before entering your home desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a workspace calibration screen inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with strong support ticket evidence; requires a new screen but flow changes show upside.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Companion Preview Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new pet preview screen immediately after story introduction to show live pet behaviors before path selection.
candidates.why: Choose_path step has high mean drop-off time (514s); providing an immediate preview sets expectations and motivates path selection.

new_preview_companion.headline: Meet Your Future Desktop Friend
new_preview_companion.body: See how pets sit on your desktop while you work and play.

guard.reason: Adding a pet preview screen after the story screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targeted step drop-off is moderate and adding new screens carries friction risk based on historical data.

candidates.title: Deferred Sign-In After Adoption Selection
candidates.change: Reorders sign-in so that users select their pet companion choices before creating or linking their account.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9%; letting users pick their pet first increases investment before asking for login details.

guard.reason: Moving sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users; reordering to delay sign-in reduces friction upfront.

candidates.title: System Notification Desktop Visibility Check
candidates.change: Enables desktop ready notification switch and visibility check status while background assets prepare.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) and 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop launch.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Sanctuary
waiting.body: We will send a notification the moment your companion is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen features with ready notifications is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by both tickets and time data; home notifications previously showed positive +4.1% lift.

candidates.title: First Day Desktop Care Reward Badge
candidates.change: Displays a Founding Caregiver completion badge on the home intro screen upon finishing onboarding.
candidates.why: Finish conversion is 64.8% with an overall finish rate of 23.7%; adding a visual completion badge encourages final step completion.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home!
home_intro.body: Your companion is ready on your desktop. Finish setup to claim your Founding Caregiver Badge.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy must not mention gifts or free extras such as claiming a reward badge.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Readiness Progress Counter
candidates.change: Adds explicit step counter and progress bar to the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes mean 2336s; visual progress status reassures users during asset preparation.

waiting.headline: Creating Companion Graphics
waiting.body: Finalizing pet animations and desktop collision boundary models.

guard.reason: Adding rendering progress details to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 2 prior tests.

candidates.title: Quick Path Selection Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit guidance text hint on the story screen explaining path options upfront.
candidates.why: Choose path step takes mean 514s; providing early clarity reduces indecision before reaching the choice screen.

story.hint: In the next step, pick whether to adopt a classic pet or create a custom pet from photos.

guard.reason: Adding guidance hints on the story screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Simple hint addition on path selection has minimal historical impact.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Quality Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Updates photo upload headline and body copy to specify clear photo requirements for AI pet generation.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Clear, well-lit photos ensure your custom desktop pet render turns out accurate and detailed.

guard.reason: Updating photo upload copy for clear pet guidance is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addressed by support tickets, but copy changes consistently show weak or no effect across past tests.

candidates.title: Checklist Layout for Pet Creation Upload Screen
candidates.change: Switches the photo upload screen layout to a checklist format with visual verification points.
candidates.why: Support emails show bugs with custom pet generation; a structured checklist helps users upload high-quality source photos.

upload_photos.headline: Photo Quality Checklist
upload_photos.body: Ensure high render quality by following photo recommendations.

components.text: Single pet visible with clear lighting and neutral background

guard.reason: Redesigning the upload screen to a checklist layout is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption layout changes previously resulted in neutral to slightly negative lift (-0.2%).
